signatures.description: Model the sender and receiver halves of a TCP connection that exchanges SACK blocks (including DSACK), advances a RACK-style reordering window from per-segment send and ACK timestamps plus the min-RTT, marks scoreboard holes as lost, and detects spurious retransmissions so the congestion window and ssthresh can be undone Eifel-style. Given a trace of segments, ACKs and timestamps, compute the final cwnd and ssthresh, the exact scoreboard holes, and the ordered list of spurious-retransmit events. The trace deliberately includes reneging receivers, partial ACKs, and an ACK whose cumulative point disagrees with the SACK scoreboard.
